title: Wyndham Nashville
description:
Your family will be close to many things when you stay at this centrally-located place and enjoy the tourism of Nashville and its HOT chicken and more. You are near Gaylord, Grand Ole Opry, Opry Mills Outlet Mall and more.  This location is approximately 15 minutes from downtown. There is lots of tour, food options and more. I am also happy to provide a list of things to do or check out trip advisor and Groupon for deals.

The space
1 or 2 bedroom options

With this resort property you have the options to rent 1 bedroom (sleeps up to 4). It provides a master bedroom and sleeper sofa. Or a 2 bedroom (sleeps up to 8). Master bedroom, 2nd bedroom has 2 full or queen size beds, and a sleeper sofa. The cost depends on the type of apartment you rent.

Guest access
Guest have full access to the resort while staying there. Once you check in Wyndham staff will provide all the details.
